scale: generated Horn ontologies g04281, g13278, g15813 and small-13278, GO 2026-07-26, ChEBI lite 256 and ORE 2015 files ore_ont_8737, ore_ont_16744, ore_ont_9855, ore_ont_3836, ore_ont_13482, ore_ont_4510, ore_ont_12901, ore_ont_14817 and ore_ont_9663 on atlas, and a taxonomy sweep of GO, ChEBI lite, 298 ORE 2015 EL files and 207 DL development files on the laptop

sides.lane: 1ffed4a8, the dominated successors of item 710 and the least unions of item 969 with the first review fixes
sides.tip: efca1c26, the lane after the cheaper sort of dominated successors, in timing2
sides.final: a370d073, the lane tip with the charges of the sort batched in the activation, in timing_final as tip4; the sweep ran efca1c26, and the commits after it change only accounting and inlining

manifest.build: mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify on stanley, copied to atlas

settings.threads: one and four in the rounds, four for the disjunctive attempts, one and eight in the sweep
settings.scope: one process per run in a 13 GiB systemd scope without swap on atlas, a 12 GiB scope on the laptop
settings.lock: the atlas parts ran under ~/lanes/.heavy.lock with no other benchmark or gate on the host

method: timing.sh ran three rounds of alternating order of base and lane, one process per side, file and thread count with --repeat 5, then three rounds of each side on ore_ont_14817 and ore_ont_9663 on four threads with their wall times. timing2.sh ran four rounds of alternating order of base and tip on the Horn files, then three runs of the tip on the two disjunctive files, and timing4.sh ran the same with the final build. summ.py takes the median of every classification of a side and the median of the rounds ratios. The sweep classified each file once per side and thread count with its taxonomy on the laptop and compared the sorted taxonomies hashes.
